blocks.text: Add a **Habit** for anything you want to do regularly, and bump its *streak* every time you follow through.
Set the frequency: Daily or Weekly.
Update **Streak** and **Last done** when you finish.
Broke a streak? Set it to zero and move on — the [By frequency board](anytype://object?objectId=type-habit) shows what needs attention today.
